    Images, kernels and preimages of subobjects in an abelian category #

    Small lemmas about Subobject used throughout: the image of a morphism is the kernel of its cokernel, a subobject is the kernel of its cokernel, images are monotone, and the preimage p⁻¹(U) of a subobject U of the target of p, defined as the kernel of X ⟶ Y ⟶ Y/U. For an epimorphism p the image of p⁻¹(U) is U, and for a subobject S containing ker p the preimage of p(S) is S.
